action.command: cd /workspace && cat .fvmrc && ls -la .fvm/ && readlink -f .fvm/flutter_sdk && echo "---BUILD---" && ls -la build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---KEYS---" && ls -la android/app/key.properties android/app/release.keystore assets/keys/api_keys.json 2>&1 && echo "---GRADLE PROPS DIFF---" && git --no-pager diff android/gradle.properties
